digest.component_or_area: Review gates discovery and execution framework
propositions: Plan review and code review must derive selection decisions from a single immutable effective-policy snapshot including built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, routing, prompts, applicability, and digest instead of partially independent registry paths
A shared discovery executor must own typed unit outcomes, usage, budget enforcement, cancellation, and success-only checkpoint mechanics while gate strategies retain context and topology rules
Project code-review LLM criteria must require non-empty repository-relative glob lists with migration from empty list semantics to explicit repository-wide convention via ["**"]

Code review and plan review must preserve their existing sequential/concurrent execution, topology, and checkpoint behavior while migrating to digest-complete success-only checkpoint namespace with typed discovery trace for audit and diagnostics

rebar review-plan --retry must reuse content-identical successes and retry only missing calls with fresh attempt budget, refusing stale lineage before any model call, and be documented across all canonical CLI surfaces
The workflow editor must separate editable Authored Workflow from read-only Effective Policy and reject empty project code-review LLM glob lists with automatic ["**"] remediation
